scope: Six layouts rendered; independent HP/XP, native map, settings skins, full stats and return button checked. Naxx is a manual skin in the Elwynn scene. No native combat, Naxx encounter, boss, co-op or card-choice acceptance.
knownLimitations: Illustrations are generated interpretations, not extracted official models.
